metadata.title: Implement Observation Generation with Gradient Sampling

story.iWant: agents to receive local gradient information within observation radius
story.soThat: agents can learn from partial observability constraints
story.tasks:
- Replace placeholder _get_observation() implementation (AC: #1, #2) - Remove TODO comment and dummy values - Calculate observation window: [position - radius, position + radius] - Generate n_gradient_samples points using np.linspace(window_left, window_right, n_gradient_samples) - Clip sample positions to function bounds using np.clip(positions, bounds[0], bounds[1])
- Implement gradient function evaluation (AC: #2, #3) - Call function.evaluate(gradient_positions, current_timestep) for vectorized evaluation - Ensure result is float64 numpy array - Verify array shape matches n_gradient_samples - Store result as 'gradient' in observation dict
- Implement reward calculation (AC: #3) - Evaluate function at current agent position using function.evaluate(position, timestep) - Extract scalar reward value (first element if array returned) - Store as float (float64) in observation dict - Ensure reward is single float, not array
- Build complete observation dictionary (AC: #1, #4, #5, #6) - position: self.state['position'] as float - reward: calculated reward value as float - gradient: function values array (shape: n_gradient_samples) - gradient_positions: sample x-coordinates array (shape: n_gradient_samples) - timestep: self.state['timestep'] as int - Verify all arrays use float64 dtype - Verify shapes: gradient and gradient_positions both (n_gradient_samples,)
- Validate performance requirements (AC: #7) - Profile _get_observation() execution time - Ensure < 5ms for default 20 samples - Verify vectorized function call (single evaluate() call for all samples) - Document any performance considerations in docstring
- Update and validate tests (AC: #1-7) - Update test_observation_dict_structure to verify real gradient arrays - Update test_observation_dict_types to check float64 dtypes - Add test_observation_gradient_sampling to verify gradient sampling logic - Add test_observation_reward_calculation to verify reward computation - Add test_observation_performance to verify < 5ms execution - Run all tests and ensure they pass

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**Given** Environment class from Story 2.2 **When** I implement _get_observation() private method **Then** it generates observation dict with all required keys: - `position`: Current agent x-coordinate (float) - `reward`: Current reward at position (float) - `gradient`: NumPy array of function samples within observation radius - `gradient_positions`: NumPy array of x-coordinates where samples were taken - `timestep`: Current timestep (int)
**And** gradient sampling: - Creates n_gradient_samples points uniformly within [position - radius, position + radius] - Evaluates function at all sample points using vectorized NumPy call - Clips sample positions to respect function bounds - Uses np.linspace for uniform sampling
**And** current reward is calculated by evaluating function at agent position
**And** all numeric values use float64 precision
**And** gradient array shape is (n_gradient_samples,)
**And** gradient_positions array shape is (n_gradient_samples,)
**And** method completes in < 5ms for 20 samples (vectorized evaluation)

story-context.constraints: - **Observation Dict Contract**: Keys MUST be exactly: position, reward, gradient, gradient_positions, timestep (matches Agent interface requirement) - **Float64 Precision**: All numeric values must use np.float64 for reproducibility (NFR11) - **Vectorized Operations**: Use single function.evaluate() call for all gradient samples (no Python loops) - **Performance Target**: Complete execution in < 5ms for 20 samples (part of NFR3 episode performance budget) - **Bounds Enforcement**: Gradient positions must be clipped to function.bounds to prevent out-of-bounds evaluation - **NumPy-style Docstrings**: Maintain docstring format with Parameters, Returns, Notes, Examples sections - **Testing Requirement**: Update existing tests and add new tests for gradient sampling, reward calculation, and performance

interface.name: Function2D.evaluate
interface.signature: def evaluate(self, x: np.ndarray, t: float) -> np.ndarray
interface.usage: Call self.function.evaluate(gradient_positions, self.state['timestep']) for vectorized gradient sampling and self.function.evaluate(np.array([self.state['position']]), self.state['timestep']) for reward

interface.name: Function2D.bounds
interface.usage: Access via self.function.bounds to get (left_bound, right_bound) for clipping gradient_positions

interface.name: Environment.state
interface.signature: self.state: Dict = {'position': np.float64, 'timestep': int, 'cumulative_reward': np.float64, 'history': list}
interface.usage: Access position via self.state['position'] and timestep via self.state['timestep'] for observation generation

interface.name: observation dictionary
interface.usage: Return dict from _get_observation() with exact keys. gradient and gradient_positions must be shape (n_gradient_samples,) with float64 dtype

tests.standards: Use pytest framework per Architecture standards. Test files in tests/ directory. Follow existing test patterns from test_environment.py with class-based organization (TestEnvironmentInitialization, TestEnvironmentReset, TestEnvironmentIntegration). Use pytest fixtures from conftest.py (gaussian_function). Validate float64 precision explicitly with isinstance(value, np.float64). tests.ideas:
**AC1 (Observation dict keys)**: Update test_observation_dict_structure to verify gradient arrays are non-empty after implementation
**AC2 (Gradient sampling)**: Add test_observation_gradient_sampling to verify: - Gradient array length equals n_gradient_samples - Gradient positions within observation window [position - radius, position + radius] - Gradient positions clipped to function bounds when window extends beyond - Uniform spacing between samples (np.linspace behavior) - Gradient array shape is (n_gradient_samples,) - gradient_positions array shape is (n_gradient_samples,)
**AC3 (Reward calculation)**: Add test_observation_reward_calculation to verify: - Reward matches function.evaluate at agent's position - Reward is scalar float, not array - Reward uses float64 precision
**AC4 (Float64 precision)**: Update test_observation_dict_types to verify: - gradient dtype is np.float64 - gradient_positions dtype is np.float64 - reward is float (converted from float64 array)
**AC5-6 (Array shapes)**: Add shape assertions in gradient sampling test: - assert gradient.shape == (env.n_gradient_samples,) - assert gradient_positions.shape == (env.n_gradient_samples,)
**AC7 (Performance)**: Add test_observation_performance: - Use timeit to measure _get_observation() execution - Assert average time < 5ms over 100 iterations - Verify single vectorized function call (no loops)
**Integration test**: Test with custom observation_radius and n_gradient_samples to ensure configuration flexibility
